title: School 4
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Node status checked first: `coming`, so inside P-b2c1-stub. This theme was the most heavily pre-taught of the whole batch. a1_school (24), a1_school_2 (22) and a2_school (28) cover the classroom and the subjects, and a B1 unit has already taken the university layer — the first sweep returned assignment, coursework, tutor, lecture, seminar, undergraduate, degree, diploma, certificate, qualification, term, semester, revise, revision, scholarship, tuition and mark ALL as taught, nineteen of thirty-seven candidates. The corrected pool also caught postgraduate (b2_prefixes_2) and peer pressure (leaf_relationships_b2), both drafted earlier today. It took two sweeps to find 36 clean words. What survives is the institution and the learning rather than the classroom: how education is organised (curriculum, syllabus, module, academic year, state and private and boarding school, headteacher, campus, vocational, mixed ability), HOW YOU ACTUALLY STUDY (study skills, note-taking, mind map, rote learning, by heart, cram, procrastinate, distance learning, lifelong learning) — which no earlier unit touches at all, though it is what a student does every day — and what goes wrong (attendance, absence, truancy, plagiarism, invigilator, pass mark, resit, drop out, underachieve). C57 card 0 recaps School 1 to 3. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: School 1, 2 and 3 gave you the classroom and the subjects — class, lesson, homework, exam, essay, lecture, professor, degree, university, biology, chemistry, physics, maths, research. A later unit added the university words: assignment, coursework, tutor, seminar, qualification, scholarship, tuition. Those carry the sentences here. What is new is how the whole thing is organised, how you actually study, and what happens when it goes wrong.
cards.note_cz: School 1, 2 a 3 ti daly třídu a předměty — class, lesson, homework, exam, essay, lecture, professor, degree, university, biology, chemistry, physics, maths, research. Pozdější lekce přidala univerzitní slova: assignment, coursework, tutor, seminar, qualification, scholarship, tuition. Ta slova nesou zdejší věty. Nové je, jak je to celé uspořádané, jak se doopravdy učíš a co se stane, když se to pokazí.

cards.title: Four ways to learn something
cards.title_cz: Čtyři způsoby, jak se něco naučit
points: These four are not the same thing, and only one of them lasts.
English separates them; a single Czech word often does not.

rows: you can say it word for word
repeating until it sticks — fine for dates
all of it the night before, then gone
the methods that make the other three unnecessary
